-- [AP27: playlist key opens the Queue tab] while a video that was started from the Queue plays, the playlist key / button opens the Queue tab
-- (the tab buttons use script-message ap-playlist-direct to reach the Playlist tab on purpose). Every decision is logged in ap-gate.log.
function ap_gate_log(text)
	pcall(function()
		local f = io.open(mp.command_native({'expand-path', '~~/'}) .. 'ap-gate.log', 'ab')
		if f then f:write(os.date('%H:%M:%S '), text, '\n'); f:close() end
	end)
end
function ap_playlist_gate(creator, opts)
	local open = creator(opts)
	return function()
		local function is_open(t) local ok, r = pcall(function() return Menu:is_open(t) end) return ok and r end
		local flag = mp.get_property('user-data/ap/queue-playing')
		local direct = mp.get_property('user-data/ap/playlist-direct')
		if is_open('ap_queue') and direct ~= 'yes' then ap_gate_log('queue menu was open -> close'); Menu:close() return end   -- (build 35) the Playlist TAB of the Queue menu sets direct=yes: open the playlist then, do not just close
		if flag == 'yes' and direct ~= 'yes' and not is_open('playlist') then
			ap_gate_log('queue video playing -> Queue tab')
			mp.commandv('script-message', 'ap-queue-menu')
			return
		end
		ap_gate_log('playlist key -> Playlist tab (flag=' .. tostring(flag) .. ', direct=' .. tostring(direct) .. ')')
		open()
	end
end
bind_command('playlist', ap_playlist_gate(create_self_updating_menu_opener, {
